cards.observation_text: The lineage comparison excludes the branch of living trunked giants.
cards.inference_text: The sample belongs elsewhere on the mammal family tree.
cards.bonus_fact_text: Golden moles share an ancient African lineage with elephants, tenrecs, and aardvarks.
hints: The family tree shares old roots with giants but takes another branch.
The genetic trail turns away from trunk-bearing mammals.
Ancient African ancestry is present without the heaviest body plan.
Field team: follow the smaller offshoot of this deep lineage.

cards.observation_text: The body covering lacks an outer coat of overlapping armor scales.
cards.inference_text: Fur, sparse hair, and exposed skin remain compatible with this finding.
cards.bonus_fact_text: Its compact body and powerful foreclaws are specialized for moving through sand.
hints: The surface sample feels soft rather than plated.
No shingle-like armor appears along the back.
The protective covering bends continuously instead of overlapping.
Field team: the body scan found no keratin shield.

cards.observation_text: The feeding behavior record excludes stalking and ambushing large prey.
cards.inference_text: Keep the candidates that gather plants or search for smaller food.
cards.bonus_fact_text: It travels through loose coastal dunes in shallow tunnels that can leave subtle surface ridges.
hints: The trail is continuous and close to the ground, not a patient stalk.
No waiting point overlooks a prey path.
Movement notes show searching rather than a sudden pounce.
Field team: this subject is not shadowing a large target.

cards.observation_text: The diet is not centered on fruit and flowers.
cards.inference_text: The candidate that specializes in those foods can be set aside.
cards.bonus_fact_text: Its diet is expected to center on small invertebrates found in sandy soils.
hints: The meal trace lies below the branches.
No fruit pulp or flower fragments appear at the feeding site.
The foraging path runs through substrate rather than foliage.
Field team: search low for very small animal prey.

cards.observation_text: The native range falls outside the Sahara and its southern dryland fringe.
cards.inference_text: The desert specialist tied to that region is a mismatch.
cards.bonus_fact_text: The known habitat lies in the coastal dunes of South Africa's Namaqualand region.
hints: These dunes meet cool coastal air rather than an inland desert belt.
The map point sits well south of the great northern desert.
Ocean influence reaches this sandy habitat.
Field team: shift the map toward Africa's southwestern coast.
